title: Free generators on the standard projective-line charts
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $P=\mathbf P^1_k$ with standard charts $U_i$ [def-sc-p1-standard], and $L$ an invertible $\mathcal O_P$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. For every $i\in\{0,1\}$ there exists $g_i\in\Gamma(U_i,L)$ which is a free generator on every subopen of $U_i$ [def-sc-local-free-generator].

source.place: Tag 0BXJ, divisors-lemma-Pic-projective-space-UFD, proof specialized to n=1 over a field; StandardChartFrames

proof.text: The source polyEquivChart identifies each chart ring with k[t], taking the other coordinate as variable. Transport the domain and PID instances of [lem-pur-polynomial-field-pid] across this ring equivalence.

The section module of L on the affine chart is invertible by [lem-sc-affine-invertible-sections]. Over the PID chart ring [lem-pur-pid-invertible-module-trivial] (implemented by CommRing.Pic.mk_eq_one_iff and the subsingleton instance) supplies a linear isomorphism of sections with the ring.

The inverse image of 1 is a generator of the section module. The proved source theorem Scheme.Modules.isFreeGenerator_of_bijective_smul localizes this basis to basic opens and then all subopens, so this section is a free generator in the sense of [def-sc-local-free-generator].
